entries.04e47cbea631f137: A comprehensive manufacturer of dental materials and equipment with its head office in Higashiyama-ku, Kyoto, it forms a group with 18 consolidated subsidiaries, 1 equity-method affiliate and 1 other affiliated company. entries.22fc1b976e61b0f4: The reportable segments are three: the Dental Business, the Nail Business and the Other Business. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥37,669 million for the Dental Business, accounting for the bulk of consolidated revenue of ¥39,994 million; ¥2,225 million for the Nail Business; and ¥99 million for the Other Business. entries.26ca47319c82a89e: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 3.3% year on year to ¥39,994 million. The analysis of operating results explains that in Japan, CAD/CAM-related products, such as resin materials for dental milling and ceramics, contributed to sales, and that overseas, sales of dental filling and restorative materials in North America, Central and South America and China, and of CAD/CAM-related products in Europe, remained firm.

entries.3d23b921e4c19089: Since its founding in 1922 as a manufacturer of artificial teeth, the company has developed its business as a comprehensive manufacturer offering a wide range of dental materials and equipment, from artificial teeth to abrasives, chemical products, cements, and machinery and equipment. The company has manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in Japan and overseas, and in research and development it is advancing product development in chairside products, labside products, orthodontic materials and digital dentistry.
